description: PatientID must be present for source-level duplicate checking.
Duplicate source patient identifiers; review and resolve before analysis. No rows are auto-deleted.
Age must be numeric and within broad technical screening bounds 0–120; not a clinical judgement.
Dosage must be numeric and greater than zero; medication-specific appropriateness is not assessed.
Treatment duration must be numeric and greater than zero.
Readmitted must be Yes or No; unknown values are not inferred.
BloodPressure must match numeric systolic/diastolic text format; this does not assess clinical normality.
CholesterolLevel must be numeric and non-negative. Unit and measurement context are not supplied.
